reviews.title: It’s exhausting and repetitive
reviews.text: I’ve been playing for way over a year and as much as I love Eminence it’s hard to stick with this no matter how hard I try. I saved up 20k gems after months of skipping and just wasted it all on a 150% perfect up banner to not even get a single SS let alone the one I’m pulling for. It’s the same thing every time. Even if you put money in, hundred of dollars later and still not even close to to getting them. I understand every game needs to make money but no way after a year all my gems gone and not 1 character I wanted. If you want to replay the story then play the game and push through watching the characters do the same thing over and over and over and over again. If you are not a big fan don’t bother. Even after spending money you’ll not be satisfied

reviews.title: My One Issue
reviews.text: Personally this game is great. From the story telling to the epic animated scenes this game has been nothing but amazing in my eyes. I absolutely love the difficulty to get rewards and the gameplay. In addition, the constant events that roll through help keep the game refreshing. However, I harbor one issue with this game. It’s too large. This game takes up GBs of storage on my phone and absolutely clogged up my iCloud storage. If this game wasn’t so good i wouldn’t be worrying about my storage on my device. Other than that this game is worth the time if you enjoyed The Eminence in Shadow series, and I really enjoy the expansion on the lore through the shadow chronicles. The game is also great at expanding on the relationships between characters as we get to see different perspectives throughout the game.

reviews.title: Linking system needs improvement
reviews.text: I usually don’t give reviews (just 4-5 stars if I like the game) but I feel like I need to give proper feedback on this game. First of all love the story and how it mixes light novel information with the anime, unique story events are super fun, the gear and rank system is unique and fun to grind when I’m not busy and as abysmal as the summoning rates are it’s fun and rewarding when you finally pull the character you wanted (seriously though please improve the rates for the tutorial summon, I feel like one guaranteed SS character isn’t too much to ask for). With all the good points covered let’s talk about why I gave it a 3 star rating: the linking system is by far the worst I have ever seen, I feel like most players like having side accounts to play on when the grind of the main seems like too much hassle, that said it’s kind of hard to have a side account when somehow they all have the same binding, or when you want to delete an account and find out it’s somehow still linked even though you’ve deleted 4 separate times. I’ve lost accounts and money because of this system but I keep coming back because I love the game in its entirety. Sorry it’s been so wordy but to summarize my critiques of improvement are: summoning rates, stamina and the most important the linking system. I feel like it could be solved with a login system. Ex: player I.D. and a password, they don’t login for a certain amount of time; delete their account. This gives players a reliable way to login and have side accounts while ensuring that if they want to keep account they login and play. Ok that’s enough from me, if you got this far thank you, stay safe and have a good rest of your day!
